column3: “Apostles” and “for a living” are supplied; not having a right not to work is recast as having to work.
“Drink” replaces eat in the final question.
“The harvest” specifies the unexpressed object of sharing.
“Your support” specifies the right over you.
“Rights” specifies “these”; BSB follows the Textus Receptus construction (“than let anyone nullify”), while the critical text breaks off: “rather die than — no one will empty my boast.”
“In preaching it” renders in the gospel.
“Of obligation” is supplied; “as many as possible” renders the more.
“Its blessings” specifies the unexpressed object of sharing.
